rounds.response:
Quick read: signup completion is steady but activation (users reaching their first core action within 3 days) has softened—most pronounced on mobile web—so the primary problem looks like failures in the post-signup “first-success” path and mobile UX rather than acquisition or signup.  
- Mobile web friction: slow loads, layout/interaction issues and low CTA prominence are likely causing users to drop off before attempting the core action.  
- Weak first-success path: unclear next steps, lack of templates/default content and no surfaced onboarding checklist mean users don’t know how to reach an immediate win.  
- Sparse or mistimed contextual guidance: in-app tips, emails/pushes, and microcopy are either missing or not targeted, so users don’t get the right nudge at the right moment—this likely worsens on small screens.  
If that matches your read, I’ll proceed to draft the full proposal (metrics, candidate solutions, prioritized backlog) tomorrow.
